No fixed Jetty 10.x release is published yet (upstream latest is 10.0.26). Solr 9 embeds Jetty 10.x and cannot move to Jetty 12.x without an upstream Solr code change. Solr 10 pins jetty 12.0.36 and is outside this PURL scope.

Host/authority confusion in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 requests where Host header and :authority pseudo-header do not match. No fix available for Jetty 9.4.x line (affected range >=9.4.0.v20161208,<=9.4.58.v20250814). Upgrading to Jetty 10+ requires Java 11+ and source changes. Monitoring for upstream backport or evaluating upgrade path.

Cruise Control still depends on Jetty 9.4.x. That line is end-of-life with no public OSS release fixing CVE-2026-6790 (community fixes are on Jetty 12.0.35+ / 12.1.9+). A Jetty major upgrade for Cruise Control has not been validated yet.

CVE-2026-6790 affects jetty-server across multiple versions used by Spark. No fixed version is available in the advisory. Waiting for upstream Jetty to release a fix.

Jetty is present only as a transitive dependency of hadoop-common, via the iceberg-source plugin. Data Prepper references no org.eclipse.jetty class and never instantiates a Jetty Server; HTTP ingestion uses Armeria/Netty and the management API uses com.sun.net.httpserver. The vulnerable jetty-server request-handling code is never on an execute path.

No fixed version available for the 9.4.x branch. The Jetty 9.4.x line is EOL with the last release being 9.4.56.v20240826. Upstream Apache ZooKeeper 3.8.6 and 3.9.5 pin jetty.version=9.4.58.v20250814. Upgrading to a supported Jetty version (10.x, 11.x, or 12.x) would require migration to jakarta.servlet API, which is not currently validated for ZooKeeper's admin server.
